Aptos Labs Unveils MonoMove Upgrade With Up to 55x Faster Smart Contract Execution in Tests

Aptos Labs announced MonoMove, a proposed upgrade to the Aptos execution engine. In internal tests, some smart contract workloads ran up to 55x faster than on the current Move VM, while separate benchmarks showed up to 11x higher end-to-end sequential throughput. Subject to governance approval, MonoMove is expected to reach feature completeness by the end of 2026, with mainnet rollout planned for 2027. — link

Binance October Proof of Reserves Shows User BTC Holdings Up 0.91% to 688,600 BTC

Binance released its October proof-of-reserves data, based on an October 1 snapshot. User BTC holdings stood at approximately 688,600 BTC, up 0.91% from September 1, an increase of 6,217 BTC. User ETH holdings fell 4.61% to about 3.799 million ETH, down roughly 183,600 ETH. User USDT holdings declined 0.87% to approximately 32.03 billion USDT, a decrease of about 280 million USDT, while user BNB holdings fell 0.77% to around 43.04 million BNB, down roughly 334,200 BNB. — link

Prediction Market Volume Hits Record $188B in Q3, Up Nearly 70% QoQ

CryptoRank data shows prediction market trading volume reached a record $188 billion in Q3 2026, up nearly 70% quarter-over-quarter and about 21 times higher than Q3 2025. CryptoRank said Kalshi was the main driver of the growth, with sports markets accounting for roughly 40% of its Q3 trading volume. Kalshi has expanded its share across several prediction-market categories, while Polymarket continues to maintain a strong position in political markets. — link

OKX Raises New Funding at $25B Valuation From Circle, Ripple, SC Ventures and QRT

Bloomberg reported that crypto exchange OKX has raised a new round at a $25 billion valuation, with investors including Circle, Ripple, Standard Chartered’s SC Ventures, and London-based quantitative hedge fund Qube Research & Technologies (QRT). The size of the round was not disclosed. The financing extends OKX’s March raise, when NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) invested about $200 million at the same valuation. OKX said the new capital will be used to strengthen its long-term market infrastructure.
